description: Place a real outbound call only to a user-authorized destination. Requires confirm=true and a stable idempotency_key. This is not a sandbox simulation. Preserve the returned ID; never redial after an uncertain timeout.

agent_id.description: Omni agent that handles the connected call.

from_number_id.description: Active managed-number ID to present as caller ID.

use_case.description: Declared calling purpose. Determines consent, identity, CNAM, and policy gates.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user authorizes this exact purchase or destination.

idempotency_key.description: Required safe-retry key. Identical retries return the original call; a different body returns 409.
